name: browsermcp-monorepo
description: Use the browser as a local MCP runtime through a reusable web library and cross-platform bridge.

scripts.build: npm run build:bridge:bundle && npm run build:site
scripts.build:bridge: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace @browsermcp/bridge
scripts.build:site: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace @browsermcp/site
scripts.build:web: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace @browsermcp/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration --workspace @browsermcp/bridge && npm run test:integration --workspace @browsermcp/site && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:libs && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run build:bridge && tsc -p tsconfig.json --pretty false && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
